description: Generated edge-case vectors. Expected signatures and hashes were produced by hw's signMessage (commit 2ebb5e7) and independently verified with Bitcoin Core 25.0 verifymessage and a separate Python implementation. The expected warnings were written by hand. Vectors in "rejected" must make signMessage fail.

vectors.name: edge/replacement-character
vectors.edgeCase: U+FFFD, what a non-ASCII argument became in a process without a UTF-8 locale

key.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

vectors.comment: Two U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTERs (3 UTF-8 bytes each). Before hw forced UTF-8 (setUtf8Encoding), the argument "café" became this in a process without a UTF-8 locale (one U+FFFD per undecodable byte of é), and the altered message was signed silently: this is the signature hw 0.9.5 produced for "café" under LANG=C. The characters themselves are valid and signed byte for byte: the signature differs from nfc-e-acute. Header byte 31 (recovery id 0).

vectors.name: edge/passphrase-unicode

key.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

vectors.comment: KNOWN BIP-39 DEVIATION: BIP-39 requires NFKD normalization of the passphrase, but hw passes it to haskoin-core's mnemonicToSeed unchanged and haskoin-core does not normalize (documented in anyToSeed). For this passphrase (ä/ö in NFC form), BIP-39 compliant wallets derive a different key and address. This vector records the current behaviour; it must be updated if normalization is added. Header byte 31 (recovery id 0).
